illustrates.quote: d. Subentry. A subentry is an entry that is subservient to the main entry. It may be a definition, another part of speech, another form of spelling, or a cross-reference.

blocks.text: pre-sen-ta-tion \pre′-zen-tā′-shən\ n (15 c) 1 a : the act of presenting b : the act, power, or privilege esp. of a patron of applying to the bishop or ordinary for instituting someone into a benefice 2 : something presented: a : a symbol or image that represents something b : something offered or given 3 : an immediate object of perception, cognition, or memory —pre-sen-ta-tion-al
blocks.features: Grey highlighting identifies the subentries, part of speech, and run-on entry. Multilevel dictionary entry (numbered/lettered definitions, a run-in derived entry) — F-193/F-195/F-200, no construct exists to build this faithfully.
